topic: Padding Rust structs for WGSL uniforms
principle: Ensure Rust structs used as WGPU uniforms have 16-byte alignment and explicit padding to match WGSL layout expectations. Uniform address space in WGSL requires that all struct members align to 16-byte boundaries — the Rust struct must add explicit padding fields and derive bytemuck::Pod + Zeroable so the byte representation is identical.
